record_type: agent-observed CPU execution transcription; not a new test run
source_basis: Original frozen grouped_pilot/source.tar.gz, before zero-head malformed-input guards
execution_command: ../venv_kvcache/bin/python - (inline stdin CPU probe; full algorithm specification recorded below)

no_drop_model_fuzz.inputs: FixedTokenizer arange3..22, 20 tokens, max_gen5, CPU; install PromptQueryCapture on same model and each policy
no_drop_model_fuzz.reference: TieredKVPolicy versus GroupedRetentionPolicy; same model weights
assertions: every final virtual-head hot position list equals corresponding global cache
final SRAM K and V per-head payload bitwise equal, rtol0/atol0

synthetic_prior_feedback_fuzz.shape: N31,W3,D6; random K/queries, deterministic per-head V=arange(heads*N)+1000*layer
synthetic_prior_feedback_fuzz.reference_prior: gqa_causal_importance(Q[head*groups:(head+1)*groups],K[head:head+1],pool_kernel=cache.cfg.pool_kernel,query_chunk128) indexed by selected SRAM absolute positions then multiplied by heads
synthetic_prior_feedback_fuzz.reference_feedback: Per corresponding query-head group mean over query heads and single query; add old-visible hot segment at _vis_sram_keep; cold segment matches position-key attention dict
assertions: hot and cold K/V bitwise match original corresponding per-head rows
prior scores match independent per-group scorer times original head count
SRAM feedback and cold attention match independent group mean
reset empties caches and head counts

compressed_decode_fuzz.algorithm: Initialize random prompt K,V,Q; retain independent per-virtual-head truth dictionary absolute_position -> original K,V. Each step append random original-model-order single-token K,V; store truth at N+step; provide independent random softmax attention weights for original query heads; call grouped update_scores then policy. Compare every retained SRAM/STT row to its original per-head truth, including recycled/promoted/shadow rows. Iterate eight parameter combinations.
assertions: all retained K and V bitwise match absolute-position oracle
sink0 and three most recent absolute positions remain hot
cold shadow flag iff corresponding position remains hot
same packed visible width across layers
global decode_step_count equals number of forwards

limitations: CPU tiny/random and synthetic correctness tests only, not full-model task quality, GPU kernel/stream behavior, performance, total memory, or concurrency evidence.
